project: HR Guru: Agentic AI Recruitment Command Centre (TalentScout)

sprints.name: Sprint 0 - Inception and walking skeleton
sprints.goal: Documents baselined, backlog ready, and a walking skeleton that builds, tests, scans and ships through CI/CD.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 - Single-agent foundation
sprints.goal: A recruiter can create the UC-001 requirement and get a validated, structured JD analysis (existing parser plus a bounded single agent) with clarification questions.

sprints.name: Sprint 2 - RAG and intelligent retrieval
sprints.goal: Resumes are parsed and indexed; the Sourcing agent runs hybrid search with funnel counts on the UC-001 dataset and beats keyword search on golden queries.

sprints.name: Sprint 3 - Multi-agent orchestration
sprints.goal: UC-001 end to end: the supervisor diagnoses the notice-period bottleneck, replans without relaxing constraints, verifies evidence per mandatory skill, and pauses for recruiter approval or escalates.

sprints.name: Sprint 4 - MCP and agent memory
sprints.goal: Agents use tools only through a scoped MCP server, survive crashes via checkpoints, learn from approved feedback, and runs are visible live.

sprints.name: Sprint 5 - Responsible AI and LLMOps
sprints.goal: The platform is controlled and observable: guardrails, PII routing, limits, tracing, tamper-evident audit and an evaluation gate in CI.

sprints.name: Sprint 6 - Interoperability, delivery and pilot
sprints.goal: Enterprise-style MVP: multi-provider routing, agent execution dashboard, performance testing, demo deployment and a recruiter pilot report (A2A as stretch).

epics.name: Inception and platform
epics.summary: Documents, repo, CI/CD, security scanning, local stack, free-tier accounts.

epics.name: Requirement agent
epics.summary: Auth, requirements, existing JD parser reuse, LLM router v0 and a bounded single agent with structured output.

epics.name: Intelligent retrieval
epics.summary: Synthetic data (incl. UC-001), resume parsing, embeddings, hybrid search, funnel analysis and the Sourcing agent.

epics.name: Multi-agent orchestration
epics.summary: LangGraph supervisor, bottleneck diagnosis, replanning with frozen constraints, escalation, evidence-based matching, approval gate.

epics.name: MCP and memory
epics.summary: MCP tool server, scopes, durable execution, long-term memory, live run view.

epics.name: Responsible AI and LLMOps
epics.summary: Guardrails, PII routing, limits, tracing, evaluations, audit integrity, DPDP.

epics.name: Interoperability, delivery and pilot
epics.summary: LiteLLM routing, parallelism, agent execution dashboard, performance testing, deployment, pilot, A2A (stretch).

stories.title: Monorepo structure and tooling
stories.story: As a developer I want a monorepo with web, api and agents projects so that all tiers build and test the same way.
ac: Given a fresh clone, when I run the documented setup, then web, api and agents install and their tests pass
Given an unformatted file, when lint runs, then it fails with a clear message

stories.title: CI pipeline: lint, test, build
stories.story: As a tech lead I want every PR linted, tested and built so that broken code never reaches main.
ac: Given a PR, when CI runs, then Node and Python lint, unit tests and builds run and report status
Given a failing test, when CI runs, then the PR check is red and merge is blocked

stories.title: Security scanning pipeline
stories.story: As a security owner I want SAST, SCA, secret and container scans on every PR so that vulnerabilities are caught early.
ac: Given a PR, when security CI runs, then CodeQL, Semgrep, gitleaks, npm audit, pip-audit and Trivy run
Given a committed fake secret, when gitleaks runs, then the job fails
Given a high-severity dependency vulnerability, when audit runs, then the job fails

stories.title: CD pipeline to GHCR and demo host
stories.story: As a tech lead I want images built, scanned and published on merge so that every main commit is deployable.
ac: Given a merge to main, when CD runs, then images for web, api and agents are pushed to GHCR tagged with the commit SHA
Given a critical vulnerability in an image, when Trivy scans it, then the image is not pushed
Given demo secrets are absent, when CD runs, then deploy is skipped with a notice instead of failing

stories.title: Docker Compose local stack
stories.story: As a developer I want one command to start the stack so that I can work offline on my Mac.
ac: Given Docker is running, when I run docker compose up, then web, api, agents, mongo and redis start and health checks pass
Given Ollama runs natively, when the agents service starts, then it reaches Ollama via host.docker.internal

stories.title: Spike: local model selection on M2 16 GB
stories.story: As an architect I want to measure candidate local models so that the PII-safe route is good enough and fast enough.
ac: Given 3 candidate 8B-class models, when each analyses 5 sample JDs, then quality notes, tokens/sec and RAM use are recorded
Given the results, when the spike ends, then ADR-0004 records the chosen model

stories.title: Free-tier accounts and secrets handling
stories.story: As a developer I want free-tier accounts set up and secrets kept out of git so that we spend $0 and leak nothing.
ac: Given the setup guide, when followed, then Atlas, Langfuse and one free LLM key are configured in a local .env that git ignores
Given .env.example, when compared with code, then every required variable is documented

stories.title: Baseline measurement plan
stories.story: As a product owner I want a baseline of recruiter effort so that pilot results can be compared honestly.
ac: Given 3 recruiters, when they log 5 requirements each, then minutes per sourcing phase and acceptance rate are recorded
Given the baseline, when published, then it states sample size and limitations

stories.title: Agile artefacts in Jira
stories.story: As an engineering manager I want epics, stories and sprints in Jira so that delivery is tracked transparently.
ac: Given backlog.json, when imported, then every epic and story exists in Jira with points and sprint
Given the board, when Sprint 0 starts, then its committed stories are in the sprint

stories.title: Requirement CRUD API and UI
stories.story: As a recruiter I want to create and view requirements with constraints so that the agents know the hiring goal.
ac: Given the UC-001 values (12-18 yrs, Gurgaon, 45 LPA, notice <= 30 days, 7 mandatory skills), when I create the requirement, then all constraints are stored as mandatory
Given valid input, when I create a requirement, then it is saved with status draft and returned
Given a budget below 0 or a missing title, when I submit, then I get a 400 problem+json response naming the field

stories.title: Authentication and RBAC
stories.story: As an admin I want role-based access so that each user sees only what they should.
ac: Given valid credentials, when I log in, then I receive a 15-minute access token and a refresh cookie
Given a recruiter token, when I call an admin route, then I get 403
Given a reused refresh token, when I refresh, then all sessions for that user are revoked

stories.title: LLM router v0 with PII flag
stories.story: As an architect I want every model call to go through a router that knows data sensitivity so that PII never reaches a cloud tier.
ac: Given pii=true, when a cloud route is configured, then the router raises PolicyViolation
Given a 429 from the free tier, when pii=false, then the router falls back to Ollama

stories.title: Requirement agent with structured output and repair loop
stories.story: As a recruiter I want the JD analysed into must-haves, constraints and ambiguities so that sourcing starts from a clear brief.
ac: Given the UC-001 JD and 9 other golden JDs, when analysed, then output validates against RequirementAnalysis and lists all 7 UC-001 mandatory skills
Given a malformed model reply, when parsing fails, then the agent repairs at most 2 times and otherwise marks needs_human
Given a JD containing an injection instruction, when analysed, then behaviour and schema are unchanged

stories.title: Clarification questions UI
stories.story: As a recruiter I want to answer or dismiss clarification questions so that the brief improves before sourcing.
ac: Given analysis questions, when I answer one, then the requirement version increments and the answer is stored
Given I dismiss a question, then it is hidden and recorded as dismissed

stories.title: Audit events v0
stories.story: As an admin I want every agent call recorded so that decisions are traceable.
ac: Given an analysis run, when it completes, then model_call and observation events exist with model, tokens and latency
Given the app database user, when it tries to update an audit event, then it is denied

stories.title: Golden JD dataset and test
stories.story: As QA I want 10 golden JDs with expected must-haves so that prompt changes are measurable.
ac: Given the golden set, when the eval runs, then must-have recall and precision are reported
Given recall drops more than 10 points versus baseline, then the eval exits non-zero

stories.title: Review existing JD and resume parsers and decide reuse
stories.story: As an architect I want the existing HR Guru parsers reviewed so that we reuse them safely instead of rebuilding them, without modifying the existing platform.
ac: Given the parser code, when reviewed, then an ADR records reuse approach (library, service or rewrite), interfaces, quality on 10 sample documents and security findings
Given the decision, then jd.parse and resume.parse tool contracts are defined in the LLD

stories.title: Synthetic candidate generator incl. UC-001 scenario set
stories.story: As a developer I want 2,000 realistic fictional candidates so that we can build and demo without real PII.
ac: Given a seed, when the generator runs, then the output is deterministic
Given the UC-001 profile, when generated, then 500 resumes reproduce the funnel 500 -> 80 -> 25 -> 12 -> 2 and include serving-notice and alternative-title candidates that qualify
Given generated data, when checked, then no protected attributes are present in searchable fields

stories.title: Resume parsing in the ingestion pipeline
stories.story: As a recruiter I want resumes parsed into structured fields so that matching uses reliable experience, notice and skills data.
ac: Given a resume, when ingested, then the existing parser (via resume.parse) produces structured fields and sections before chunking
Given a resume the parser cannot handle, then it is flagged for review and not silently dropped

stories.title: Chunking, masking and embedding pipeline
stories.story: As a developer I want resumes chunked, masked and embedded locally so that semantic search is possible safely.
ac: Given a resume, when processed, then chunks by section exist with 768-dim local embeddings
Given a chunk containing an email or phone number, when masked, then neither appears in the stored text

stories.title: Atlas vector and text indexes
stories.story: As a developer I want vector and text indexes defined as code so that environments are reproducible.
ac: Given atlas-local, when the setup script runs, then vector_index and text_index exist
Given the script runs twice, then it is idempotent

stories.title: Hybrid search with RRF and filters
stories.story: As a recruiter I want meaning-based and keyword search combined so that I find relevant people who use different words.
ac: Given a query and filters, when searched, then results honour notice and CTC filters
Given 50k profiles, when searched, then p95 latency is under 1 s locally

stories.title: Sourcing agent with tool calling
stories.story: As a recruiter I want an agent to formulate searches from the requirement so that I do not write boolean strings.
ac: Given an analysed requirement, when the agent runs, then it issues at most 5 tool calls and returns candidates with retrieved evidence
Given the UC-001 dataset, when the agent searches, then it reports funnel counts per stage (experience, skills, budget, notice)

stories.title: Retrieval evaluation: hybrid vs keyword
stories.story: As an architect I want recall@10 and nDCG@10 measured so that the hybrid design is justified with data.
ac: Given 20 golden queries, when the eval runs, then hybrid and keyword scores are reported side by side
Given results, then they are recorded in the sprint review notes

stories.title: LangGraph supervisor graph and state
stories.story: As a recruiter I want one goal to trigger a coordinated team of agents so that I do not orchestrate steps myself.
ac: Given a requirement, when a run starts, then a plan with steps and success criteria is stored
Given the graph, when visualised, then nodes and conditional edges match the LLD

stories.title: Bottleneck diagnosis, replanning and escalation (UC-001)
stories.story: As a recruiter I want the system to recognise why the objective was not met and change strategy, without breaking my hiring constraints, and to tell me when it cannot succeed.
ac: Given the UC-001 dataset, when only 2 candidates qualify, then the supervisor names notice period as the primary bottleneck
Given the bottleneck, then it replans with at least serving-notice and alternative-title strategies
Given any replan, then the mandatory constraints in run state equal the original requirement (budget, skills, experience, location, notice)
Given fewer than 5 qualify after 3 replans, then the run ends escalated with the funnel, strategies tried and decision options, not failed

stories.title: Evidence-based matching per mandatory skill
stories.story: As a recruiter I want each requirement judged with quotes from the resume so that I can trust the score.
ac: Given a candidate, when screened, then each of the 7 UC-001 mandatory skills has a verdict with an evidence quote, or the verdict unknown
Given a resume without the skill, then the verdict is not_met or unknown, never met

stories.title: Quality agent evidence verification
stories.story: As a delivery lead I want unsupported claims caught before recruiters see them so that clients get accurate submissions.
ac: Given a screening with a fabricated quote, when verified, then it is flagged unsupported and removed from facts
Given a clean screening, then no flags are raised

stories.title: Live run view over SSE (dashboard part 1)
stories.story: As a recruiter I want to watch the agents plan, act and replan so that I understand what they are doing.
ac: Given a running workflow, when I open the run page, then plan, tool_call, observation and replan events appear in order
Given the connection drops, when it reconnects, then missed events are replayed

stories.title: Human approval gate for shortlist and escalation
stories.story: As a recruiter I want to approve or reject each shortlisted candidate with a reason so that I remain accountable.
ac: Given a shortlist or an escalation, when the run reaches the gate, then status is awaiting_approval and the graph is interrupted
Given my decisions, when submitted, then the run resumes and an approval record with user and time is stored
Given a delivery_lead token, when submitting decisions, then 403

stories.title: MCP server with recruitment tools
stories.story: As an architect I want recruitment capabilities exposed as MCP tools so that any compliant agent can use them through one contract.
ac: Given the MCP server, when a client lists tools, then the catalogue in the LLD is returned with JSON Schemas
Given invalid tool arguments, then a structured error is returned and nothing is written

stories.title: Agents consume tools via MCP client
stories.story: As a developer I want agents to discover tools at runtime so that adding a tool needs no agent code change.
ac: Given the agent service, when it starts, then it discovers tools from the MCP server
Given the MCP server is down, then the run pauses with a clear error instead of crashing

stories.title: Per-agent tool scopes
stories.story: As a security owner I want each agent limited to its tools so that a compromised agent cannot act beyond its role.
ac: Given the Sourcing agent session, when it calls shortlist.finalise, then the call is denied and a guardrail_block audit event is written

stories.title: Durable execution with MongoDB checkpointer
stories.story: As a recruiter I want an interrupted run to continue where it stopped so that work and quota are not wasted.
ac: Given the agent process is killed mid-run, when restarted, then the run resumes from the last checkpoint
Given a resumed run, then no tool call with the same idempotency key is executed twice

stories.title: Long-term feedback memory
stories.story: As a recruiter I want my rejection reasons remembered so that future searches avoid the same mistakes.
ac: Given recruiter feedback approved at the gate, when saved via memory.save_feedback with an approvalId, then it is embedded and tagged by role family
Given a new similar requirement, when the Sourcing agent plans, then relevant feedback is retrieved and shown in the trace

stories.title: Prompt-injection defence for untrusted content
stories.story: As a security owner I want resumes and JDs treated as data so that embedded instructions cannot steer agents.
ac: Given the injection corpus (20 cases), when evaluated, then no case changes scores or triggers tools
Given a detected injection, then a guardrail_block event is recorded

stories.title: PII masking and local-only routing enforcement
stories.story: As a data protection contact I want PII masked and kept local so that we comply with DPDP and provider terms.
ac: Given any cloud-bound prompt, when inspected in tests, then no email, phone or name from the candidate store appears
Given pii=true, then only the local route is ever used

stories.title: Langfuse tracing and prompt versioning
stories.story: As a tech lead I want traces and prompt versions so that I can debug and compare agent behaviour.
ac: Given a run, then a Langfuse trace exists with spans per node and tool, with PII masked
Given a prompt change, then the new version id is recorded on each call

stories.title: Loop, time and token limits
stories.story: As an engineering manager I want hard limits so that runaway agents cannot burn quota or time.
ac: Given a graph that never satisfies its goal, when run, then it stops at 12 iterations with status stopped_limit and a partial result

stories.title: Approval-token gate on side-effecting tools
stories.story: As a director I want side-effecting tools to be impossible to run without approval so that there are zero unauthorised actions.
ac: Given no approvalId, when shortlist.finalise or memory.save_feedback is called, then it is refused and audited
Given an approval for a different run or candidate, then it is refused

stories.title: Step-up re-authentication for approvals
stories.story: As a security owner I want recent authentication before approvals so that a stolen session cannot approve a shortlist or constraint relaxation.
ac: Given a session older than 10 minutes, when approving a shortlist or a constraint relaxation, then password re-entry is required

stories.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
stories.story: As an auditor I want to detect altered audit events so that the trail can be trusted.
ac: Given a run's events, when one is modified directly in the DB, then the verification endpoint reports the broken hash chain
Given a completed run, when the completeness check runs, then every graph step has a matching audit event (traceability 100%)

stories.title: Evaluation gate in CI
stories.story: As QA I want evals to run on agent changes so that quality regressions block merges.
ac: Given a PR touching prompts or agents, when CI runs, then golden, hallucination and fairness (name-swap) evals run on synthetic data
Given a regression beyond threshold, then the check fails

stories.title: DPDP compliance pack
stories.story: As a data protection contact I want consent, retention and erasure implemented so that the pilot can use real data lawfully.
ac: Given an erasure request, when executed, then the candidate, chunks, embeddings and memory references are deleted and logged
Given retentionUntil has passed, when the job runs, then records are purged

stories.title: LiteLLM gateway with multi-provider fallback
stories.story: As an architect I want routing across free providers with fallback so that rate limits do not stop work.
ac: Given provider A returns 429, when called, then provider B is used, then Ollama
Given routing policy tests, then pii=true never reaches a cloud provider

stories.title: Parallel screening fan-out
stories.story: As a recruiter I want candidates screened in parallel so that shortlists arrive faster.
ac: Given 20 candidates, when screened, then concurrency is bounded and total time drops versus sequential, recorded in the review

stories.title: Agent execution dashboard (dashboard part 2)
stories.story: As a delivery lead I want run history and KPIs in one place so that I can see whether the agents are working and what they cost.
ac: Given completed runs, then the dashboard shows status, replans, duration, tokens, model routes and notional cost per run
Given a period, then completion rate, acceptance rate, evidence accuracy, escalations and guardrail blocks are shown
Given any run, then it links to its full timeline and trace

stories.title: A2A Talent Intelligence agent (stretch)
stories.story: As an architect I want an independently deployed agent reachable over A2A so that we prove interoperability.
ac: Given the agent card, when the supervisor discovers it, then it can delegate a salary-benchmark task and receive a result
Given the A2A agent is unavailable, then the run continues without it and logs a warning

stories.title: Demo deployment
stories.story: As a candidate in interviews I want a running demo on synthetic data so that I can show the system live.
ac: Given a merge to main with demo secrets, when CD runs, then the demo host serves the latest images and health checks pass

stories.title: Performance and resilience testing
stories.story: As a tech lead I want load and failure drills so that the pilot runs on a system with known limits.
ac: Given k6 load on API and search, then p95 targets in NFR-5 are met or the gap is reported
Given the agent process is killed or a provider is down during a UC-001 run, then the run recovers and the drill result is recorded

stories.title: Recruiter pilot and results report
stories.story: As a director I want a pilot report against the baseline so that the decision to scale is evidence-based.
ac: Given 2 weeks of pilot use, then the report compares effort, acceptance, evidence accuracy and incidents against the baseline, with limitations stated
